title: Milo asks you to sabotage a rival

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Hello. Could you please step aside?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello. Could you please step aside?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I need to scan that spot right there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to scan that spot right there.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I'm a Municipal Seismologist. I use sonar to detect movements in the various strata of the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm a Municipal Seismologist. I use sonar to detect movements in the various strata of the city.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Nivalis is built on top of every other city that has existed on this spot. And that creates a lot of opportunity for... instability.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nivalis is built on top of every other city that has existed on this spot. And that creates a lot of opportunity for... instability.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Wait! I do need you for something. You're a business owner, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait! I do need you for something. You're a business owner, right?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: There are various businesses that have been somewhat... intransigent when it comes to my seismology.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are various businesses that have been somewhat... intransigent when it comes to my seismology.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I have tried to purchase their properties with the discretionary funds allowed by the Nivalis Seismology Institute.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have tried to purchase their properties with the discretionary funds allowed by the Nivalis Seismology Institute.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Well, these business are obviously far too successful to accept my lowball offers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, these business are obviously far too successful to accept my lowball offers.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Nola Berg. She has been most intransigent when approached on seismology issues.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nola Berg. She has been most intransigent when approached on seismology issues.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Capital! I'll send you the addresses of a target you can sabotage. For seismology!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Capital! I'll send you the addresses of a target you can sabotage. For seismology!

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Well... I gave it a shot. See you around... if the whole city doesn't collapse into the ocean first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... I gave it a shot. See you around... if the whole city doesn't collapse into the ocean first.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I’d love to get down there and take a look, but, alas, I’m paid to use my ears, not my eyes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d love to get down there and take a look, but, alas, I’m paid to use my ears, not my eyes.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Do you know how many layers of civilizations lay under your feet?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know how many layers of civilizations lay under your feet?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: If I don't find some sort of buried treasure, they'll be paid off in five more generations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I don't find some sort of buried treasure, they'll be paid off in five more generations.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I’ve been tracking this disturbance for weeks now, and all I can do is report my findings back to HQ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ve been tracking this disturbance for weeks now, and all I can do is report my findings back to HQ.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you working on there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you working on there?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you working on there?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you working on there?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I inherited this seismograph and the rest of my tools from my father... along with the debt associated with them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I inherited this seismograph and the rest of my tools from my father... along with the debt associated with them.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: In Nivalis, the older the technology looks - if it's still working - the more valuable. This thing is an antique, but my dad had a saying. "Old things know how to find old things."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In Nivalis, the older the technology looks - if it's still working - the more valuable. This thing is an antique, but my dad had a saying. "Old things know how to find old things."

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Yes, yes, whatever. Talking actually makes it harder for me to work, so...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, yes, whatever. Talking actually makes it harder for me to work, so...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want from them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want from them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want from them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want from them?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I want them to let me do my work. I want to buy them out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want them to let me do my work. I want to buy them out.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: And you're not above some... industrial sabotage?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you're not above some... industrial sabotage?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want to buy them so you can... do more seismology?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want to buy them so you can... do more seismology?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want to buy them so you can... do more seismology?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want to buy them so you can... do more seismology?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you want me to help... how?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you want me to help... how?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you want me to help... how?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you want me to help... how?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Yes, well, if you think of a better plan, please do let me know. But for now I need you to go sabotage one of these businesses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well, if you think of a better plan, please do let me know. But for now I need you to go sabotage one of these businesses.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think I'm the right person to help you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think I'm the right person to help you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think I'm the right person to help you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think I'm the right person to help you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't there a less nefarious way to get access?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't there a less nefarious way to get access?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Isn't there a less nefarious way to get access?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Isn't there a less nefarious way to get access?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Look, I know all these business types are competing, and I'm the small fish in the big pond... but I can do this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I know all these business types are competing, and I'm the small fish in the big pond... but I can do this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I got that part. But why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got that part. But why?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I got that part. But why?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I got that part. But why?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: That's good enough. Or I am desperate enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's good enough. Or I am desperate enough.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: They value their businesses too highly. People are ALWAYS getting in the way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They value their businesses too highly. People are ALWAYS getting in the way.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: If their bottom line was suffering a little, they might be more amenable to selling up and moving on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If their bottom line was suffering a little, they might be more amenable to selling up and moving on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I see where this is going ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see where this is going ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I see where this is going ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I see where this is going ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of answer is that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of answer is that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What kind of answer is that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What kind of answer is that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What have I got to do with all of this??

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What have I got to do with all of this??
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What have I got to do with all of this??
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What have I got to do with all of this??

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I can be ruthless and put these people out of business. I can beat them all. Seismology needs me! And I will heed the call. Will you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can be ruthless and put these people out of business. I can beat them all. Seismology needs me! And I will heed the call. Will you?
